EDGAR · Electronic Data Gathering, Analysis and Retrieval

Submit Filings

The Electronic Data Gathering, Analysis and Retrieval (EDGAR) system is the primary way for companies and individuals to submit filings to the SEC in accord with the federal securities laws.

Log in and file → Apply for filer access

EDGAR portals

01 Apply for filer access → EDGAR Filer Management Portal (opens on www.filermanagement.edgarfiling.sec.gov) Submit applications for access to file on EDGAR-Form ID. Generate EDGAR access codes in the events of an expired, forgotten, or compromised password. 02 Log in and file → EDGAR Filing Portal (opens on www.edgarfiling.sec.gov) Log in and submit forms as single or bulk filings. Edit company and submission data, retrieve submission or account balance information, and view activity. 03 Submit forms → Online Forms Management Portal (opens on www.onlineforms.edgarfiling.sec.gov) Assemble and transmit XML filings or submit the following filings: Form D (registration exemption) and Forms 3, 4, 5, and 144.

Filer support and resources

  • EDGAR Filer Manual Contains requirements for becoming an EDGAR filer and the information needed for existing filers to ensure timely acceptance and processing of their filings. →
  • How Do I? guides Guides that cover various topics to help filers learn the basics of the EDGAR filing system. →
  • SEC Forms Index A list of PDF versions of the SEC forms used in public filings along with the rules, regulations, and schedules associated with these forms. →
  • Technical Specifications The SEC publishes this information to allow companies to create software or format output compatible with the EDGAR system. →
  • EDGAR Filing Fees Pay filing fees through EDGAR, and view your filing fee account — balance, last deposit and account activity. →

Filer access & account management

EDGAR Next

Compliance with the SEC’s changes to EDGAR filer access and account management (opens on federalregister.gov) is required to file on EDGAR. All filers must either be enrolled in EDGAR Next or have submitted a Form ID application for EDGAR access granted by SEC staff on or after March 24, 2025.

What EDGAR Next changes →
